title: Feedback drawer: list scrolls, comments and decision notes editable
author: builder
head: task-5-artifact-kit
body:
The drawer's list could not scroll in the bare shell and its comments could not be changed. Make the drawer a fixed-height flex column with one scrolling body, and let readers edit or delete a comment and edit a decision's note or answer.

- `artifact/host/host.css`: the drawer is a flex column; `.h-panel-body` scrolls
- `artifact/host/comments.tsx`: Edit and Delete on comments, "Change answer" on decisions
- new `test/feedback-drawer.test.ts`

Fixes #12. Follows up on example/recap-lab#9.
